description: This file provides an API client for interacting with projects-related endpoints. It includes a function to fetch project summaries with various filtering options such as date range and custom date ranges. It leverages imported functions to obtain an API client and organization ID, and makes an HTTP GET request to the '/projects/summary' endpoint, returning the response data.

methods.name: getProjectsSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of projects, optionally filtered by date range and custom date ranges, returning structured summary data.
